structural_breaks.note: Float of the Egyptian pound (≈8.9 → ≈18 EGP/USD): EGP-reported revenue of export/foreign operations roughly doubled by translation; YoY in EGP for 4Q16–3Q17 is dominated by FX. (An earlier step devaluation 7.73→8.85 took place on 14-Mar-2016.)
Acquisitions of PT CG Power Systems Indonesia and Valdius Engineering (Pakistan) — group transformer capacity to ~30,000 MVA/yr; consolidated during 2021.
EGP devaluation (~15.7 → ~18.3 per USD, CBE special MPC); 1Q22 release refers to 'the latest exchange rates' movement'.
CBE moves to a durably flexible exchange-rate regime; EGP ~19.7 → ~24 (and ~30 by Jan-2023). EGP-translated revenue inflates in 2023.
CBE lets the exchange rate be set by market forces (EGP ~30.9 → ~47-50 per USD); 1Q24 release attributes revenue growth mainly to the devaluation.

Segment re-organisation: 'Transformers' is no longer reported alone; new 'Electrical Products' segment = Transformers + Busway + Motion + E-mobility (and 'Other electrical products' moved into Wire, Cable & Accessories). Recast comparatives available only for 2024 (in 2025 releases). revenue_segment switches basis here; YoY stays like-for-like because every FY2025Q1+ point carries the company's recast EP comparative. Transformer MVA volumes continue unchanged (volume_transformers_mva).
